messages:
sara-partnerships: Quick sync — request to reallocate $75k MDF to a new SI integration pilot with SysIntegrateX. They want marketplace listing + joint announcement once 3 paid customers are onboarded. Need go/no-go before QBR on Monday.
kevin-sales: What's the proposed split between marketplace credits and co-marketing spend?
anita-ops: Rough ask from partner email: $50k marketplace credits, $25k co-marketing (MDF). Finance needs a clear acceptance gate.
kevin-sales: Agree marketplace-first. Suggest 6-month usage commitment for credits and a minimum spend KPI.
elaine-marketing: If MDF approved we can take the comms lead. Draft timeline: 2w for PR/materials + 1w legal review. Willing to own collateral.
mike-product: Product constraints: SI requests early access to private deployment API and a reserved quota. Can infra support that? pinging @eng-platform for capacity check.
eng-platform: (bot) Noted — capacity planning loop started. ETA 48h for quotas and escalation if needed.
sara-partnerships: We should also grant a temporary tier bump to Gold for SysIntegrateX for 90 days contingent on the MDF acceptance; makes partnerships dashboard cleaner for the QBR.
kevin-sales: Add KPI: partner must drive at least 10k tokens/mo per customer for first 3 customers or credits clawback.
anita-ops: Finance can provisionally hold the funds pending signed SLA and the KPI clause. I'll escalate to legal for contract language.
elaine-marketing: If we approve today timeline looks like target announcement 2026-04-05. If not, it'll slide into next quarter calendar.
sara-partnerships: Voting: react with :thumbsup: to approve realloc + temporary Gold tier, :thumbsdown: to decline. I will lock MDF allocation on Thursday 11:59pm PT.
kevin-sales: :thumbsup:
mike-product: :thumbsup:
elaine-marketing: :thumbsup:
anita-ops: :thumbsup:
sara-partnerships: Thanks — I'll update the partner playbook and QBR slide deck after votes. Draft budget doc linked (internal): https://redwood.app/drive/mdf_slate_sysintegratex_v1
deploy-bot: MDF ticket created: #MDF-4021 — https://tracker.redwood/MDF-4021
sara-partnerships: Closing thread for votes. Will post final allocation and action items in #partnerships tomorrow morning.
